## Feature Description

Provide a clear description of the proposed feature or improvement.

## Relevant Component(s)

Which component(s) of MolSanitizer would this feature affect? Select all that apply.

- [ ] Ionizer
- [ ] Tautomerizer (tautomer enumeration)
- [ ] Stereoisomerizer (stereoisomer enumeration)
- [ ] Conformer Generator (3D conformer generation)
- [ ] Molecular standardization and filtering
- [ ] File format support
- [ ] Performance and scalability
- [ ] Command-line interface (CLI)
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Other (please specify)

## Motivation and Use Case

Explain why this feature would be useful, what limitations it would address, and how it would benefit users of MolSanitizer.

## Proposed Solution (Optional)

Describe how you envision the feature being implemented. If applicable, provide examples of input molecules (e.g., SMILES), expected outputs, or suggested chemical rules (e.g., SMARTS patterns).

## Suggested References (Optional)

Provide any relevant references that could support the proposed feature, such as:

- Scientific publications (DOI or URL)
- Existing software or implementations
- Chemical databases or benchmark datasets
- Experimental evidence or established chemical rules

## Additional Context (Optional)

Provide any additional information, examples, figures, or supporting materials that may help us evaluate and implement the proposed feature.

## Contribution (Optional)

Would you be interested in contributing to the implementation or testing of this feature?

- [ ] I am willing to contribute to the implementation.
- [ ] I am willing to help test and validate the feature.
